## Change summary

Explain the behavioral change and owning module (`tensor`, `tensor_light`, or infrastructure).

## Validation

- [ ] Generic tensor test coverage was considered
- [ ] Fixed-rank tensor test coverage was considered
- [ ] Public import/module paths and header `Source:` fields were updated
- [ ] Numerical semantics and unsafe/aliasing invariants were reviewed
- [ ] `cargo test --locked` (or a documented reason it was not run)
- [ ] `cargo test --locked --all-features` (or a documented reason it was not run)
- [ ] Benchmark method, results and environment attached if performance-affecting

## Compatibility and risks

List public API changes, risk of silent plan/dtype changes, and any remaining known limitations.
